verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party feature for exporting all of an account's data in open formats, and no offboarding or data-portability path is described. What the pack does show is adjacent: paginated JSON API endpoints, an MCP server for querying account data, and a CLI with --json output. These are building blocks a user could use to assemble an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
